title: MCP overviews, skill installation and more reliable billing
summary: This release candidate adds evidence-backed MCP overviews and README browsing, makes skills easier to install from third-party agents, and improves billing reversals, approvals and streamed reasoning. Desktop installers remain unsigned manual downloads; automatic application updates are not published for this version.
items: Added MCP server README browsing and AI overviews with classification and passage-level evidence. README ingestion uses batched GitHub queries, and overview backfill has configurable batch sizes and intervals while yielding to tenant work.
Added a platform-owned system model for catalog analysis and strict JSON-schema output when supported by the provider. System calls select reasoning behavior from model metadata.

Skill pages now offer installation paths for third-party agents, show whether a skill includes scripts, and explain review status as trust. Improved skill logos, detail-page layout and install-path end-to-end coverage.

Improved payment webhook authentication, atomic order writes and draining, and refund and dispute reversals for Stripe, Creem and Waffo. Billing uses observed model-call costs and records BYOK calls at zero cost; billing screens support English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese.

Approved connector actions are claimed atomically before provider execution. Streamed reasoning is persisted in bounded windows and merged by segment ID. Desktop sign-in returns through its deep link, and Gmail access supports per-user preview settings.
Restored a two-column desktop navigation menu and consistent public-page widths, fixed Umami analytics initialization, and refreshed self-hosting and runtime configuration guidance.
Fixed sandbox warm-pool sizing to honor its configured ceiling and patched dependency advisories, including Next.js, Axios, gRPC, js-yaml, undici, fast-uri, ip-address and brace-expansion.
